title: afzelia pectinata
intro: Afzelia pectinata, commonly known as the African teak, is a tropical tree species native to West and Central Africa. The African teak is a deciduous tree valued for its timber and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Afzelia pectinata include its potential to treat fever, cough, and respiratory infections, while its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
